items.summary: The FancyBox for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Anchor 'href' Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacker to wrap the payload anchor around a smilie shortcode (e.g., :mrgreen:), which WordPress renders as an <img> element, satisfying the plugin's a:has(img) enrollment selector and disguising the malicious link as an ordinary comment emoticon.

Receiving crafted out-of-sequence DTLS handshake fragments may cause OpenSSL to allocate a full message-length reassembly buffer for each buffered message, so a small amount of wire data consumes a large amount of memory.

The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via 'wpacu_unload_css' and 'wpacu_unload_js' Query Parameters in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Successful exploitation requires that the victim has sufficient privileges to see the plugin's admin-bar entry, typically an administrator.

Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC)
eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0-resolute allows an unauthenticated remote
attacker to cause HTTP GET requests from a user's workstation by convincing the
user to open a crafted signed eDOC file. Automatic certificate validation
retrieves a signer-controlled Authority Information Access (AIA) caIssuers URL
and follows redirects without restricting the destination, enabling blind SSRF
to loopback and private-network services. Additionally, unrestricted loading of
local file URIs (such as file:///dev/zero) causes unbounded memory buffering
resulting in Denial of Service (OutOfMemoryError). In automated server
verification pipelines with UI:N, impact scales up to CVSS 8.6 High.

Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC)
eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0 for macOS allows an unauthenticated remote
attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the current user
by convincing the user to open a PDF with a crafted filename and select Send.
The application embeds the attachment path in AppleScript source without
neutralizing AppleScript syntax, allowing injected do shell script expressions
to execute.
A DANE-enabled TLS client may crash by dereferencing a NULL pointer when processing an unusual combination of certificate and TLSA records.
